regime_definition: contemporaneous quartile of realized EW-market volatility (CRSP PIT daily panel)
decision_rule: if the LOO oracle gap does not exceed the matched-transition null's 95th percentile, perfect state knowledge buys nothing this zoo can use, and REGIME-CONDITIONAL-RETURN-1 does not justify a predictor on this strategy set
scope_limits: gross of the switching cost a regime-conditional policy would actually pay — a CEILING, deliberately generous
regime defined on market volatility only; a different state variable is a different (unasked) question
the zoo is JKP long-short factors, not the mega-sweep books
